summary.text: Neal Collins is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives, representing District 5, who assumed office in 2014 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Collins advanced from the June 9, 2026 Republican primary for District 5, in which Ballotpedia reports he defeated Brandy Tarleton, 55.9 percent to 44.1 percent.

According to Ballotpedia, he was assigned to the House Ethics Committee and the Ways and Means Committee for the 2025-2026 session, and earlier served on the House Judiciary Committee, including as second vice chairman in 2021-2022.
